# EnableGadget

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [Gadgets](BlitzPlus-Gadgets)

```blitzbasic
EnableGadget gadget:Int32
```

**Works in:** BlitzPlus

Turns a gadget that was disabled with [DisableGadget](DisableGadget) back on.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
win = CreateWindow("Enable", 10, 10, 300, 140, Desktop(), 3)
a   = CreateButton("Unlock", 10, 10, 120, 28, win)
b   = CreateButton("Locked", 10, 50, 120, 28, win)
DisableGadget b
Repeat
	e = WaitEvent()
	If e = $401 And EventSource() = a Then EnableGadget b
Until e = $803
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gadget` | Int32 | required | Handle of the gadget. |
